text:
elena: Heads up — pricing experiment: 'search-embed multiplier' A/B test launching next week. Need final sign-off on grandfathering rules and invoice preview. Details below.

sam_finance: Can you paste the exact cohort criteria? We'll run a QuickBooks preview.

elena: Variant A = control (current unit price). Variant B = multiplier 0.92 on token unit. Target cohort = customers with monthly usage > $1k and signed up after 2024-01-01. Grandfathering: users who created account before 2025-06-01 get preserved rates for 90 days. Exceptions: enterprise contracts flagged "price_locked".

mira_engineering: Will runtime need tagging for variant? We need a per-customer header + rollout flag. Example header:
```
X-Pricing-Cohort: search-multiplier-b
X-Pricing-Preview: true
```

owen_sales: Need list of affected top-20 accounts for outreach. Sam, can you pull? @sam_finance

sam_finance: On it. I'll pull billing ids and send CSV by EOD. I'll include invoice preview column.

billing-bot: invoice-preview job queued (job id: ip-2290123). ETA ~ 45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

neil_ops: Also check vendor sheet 2026-07 rates — some machines were re-priced last quarter. We can't pass through higher infra costs unexpectedly.

elena: Good call. @mira_engineering can you add a preflight check: if pass-through cost delta > 5% pause rollout and alert finance channel.

mira_engineering: Yep — will add. I'll push a small check to the rollout service. snippet:
```
if infra_delta_pct > 5:
  trigger_alert('#finance')
  set_rollout_status('paused')
```

sam_finance: CSV attached (preview columns). Will run reconciliation and tag invoices with 'ABtest=search-multiplier'.

owen_sales: For outreach, let's use this script: "We are testing a billing improvement to align unit economics; this will not increase your effective monthly bill during the preview period" — want legal to approve wording.

elena: loop in legal. Deadline for signoff: 2026-04-08 17:00 PT. If no objections, plan to flip pilot 2026-04-12.

legal-bot: message received; routing to legal@redwood.com. :white_check_mark:

sam_finance: FYI invoice-preview job finished — report link: https://internal.redwood/billing/ip-2290123/report.csv

mira_engineering: Added pause check, and tagging header. Deployed to canary.

elena: Thanks team. Keep thread updates concise — just major blockers. :thumbsup:
